source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original standalone fine-art wall print for Clara Mendes, titled Orbital Silence (title is metadata only; do not render text). Generate ONE finished artwork, portrait exact 4:5 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 x 2560 pixels or highest available resolution in that ratio. Full-bleed flat artwork only. The user wants science-fiction and movie-inspired prints. Capture the contemplative scale and emotion of cinematic space exploration using an entirely invented scene. A thin monumental off-centre elliptical orbital structure drifts above a distant mineral-blue planetary horizon; an ivory crescent planet occupies the upper right with soft charcoal-shadowed curvature, a tiny abstract exploratory vessel conveys enormous scale. A subtly luminous amber trajectory sweeps through the lower half. Strong asymmetrical composition, broad midnight-indigo negative space, weathered mineral blue and antique ivory, a restrained copper accent. Material: sophisticated layered gouache, mineral pigment and hand-printed paper texture, crisp intentional silhouettes and delicately distressed edges, like a gallery art print. Atmospheric depth and extraordinary cinematic light, visually rich yet restrained enough for an elegant home. Keep all significant elements inside a 5 percent trim-safe inset; background extends fully to edges. Entirely original shapes and invented technology. No movie titles, quotes, actors, franchise logos or recognizable ships, no lettering, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no room or product mockup, no montage or grid.

source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original standalone fine-art wall print for Clara Mendes, metadata title The Fold (do not write the title). Generate ONE completed portrait artwork, exact 4:5 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 x 2560 pixels or highest available resolution in that ratio. Full-bleed flat artwork only. A sophisticated science-fiction dreamscape inspired by the cinematic language of impossible space and surreal architecture, entirely invented scene. A gigantic softly weathered ivory architectural arch stands above a pale mineral-blue sea. Within the open arch the world unexpectedly turns ninety degrees: a staircase of terracotta platforms rises sideways towards a suspended geometric city, while the ocean outside remains level and tranquil. One tiny faceless human on the lower stair gives scale and wonder. Sparse spacious composition with sweeping architectural shadows, clarity of forms, beautifully balanced negative space. Warm ivory, muted terracotta, slate-blue, soft mineral teal and deep ink shadow. Fine-art gouache, chalk pigment and subtly grainy lithographic illustration; poised sculptural geometry and painterly washes. Premium contemporary gallery print, luminous enigmatic atmosphere, convincing impossible perspective, cinematic scale but elegantly restrained for home decor. Important subjects inside 5 percent trim-safe inset; paint and background to all canvas edges. Original structures and composition, no recognizable film scenes or actors. No film title, typography, quotes, words, logos, franchise symbols, signature, watermark, border, frame, room or product mockup, montage or multi-panel layout. Artwork only.
